items.text: Any Independent RHC in Louisiana that is billing to Medicaid as secondary can help ? If Medicare crosses successfully claim is paid however when we have to send secondary electronically we see more DENIALS than claims payment 😔 Denial states Modifier inappropriate (CG is only modifier on claim) among many other denial reasons. Why would we have to remove modifier CG when it was originally on Medicare claim?? Most are Medicare Advantage Plans as primary.

topComments.text: We remove cg and send on 1500 no problem. Now Medicaid tertiary is a whole other issue 🫣

items.text: For a RHC whose providers sees nursing home patients- I know we are to bill on UB with the nursing home CPT codes, but do we put the nursing home service location and details on the claim? If not how are you billing these and are you placing CG mod?

topComments.text: In Louisiana and list the Nursing home for service location also
I’m in Mississippi and list Nursing home for service location

items.text:
We have 2 hospitals with 2 separate tax id numbers that are affiliated but still separate.  
If a patient is seen at one RHC under one tax id and then goes over to another RHC clinic at the other hospital under the other tax id, can we charge a new patient CPT code?

items.text: Does anyone know if the DSNP MCO plans in Illinois follows the same payment methodology as regular Medicare for RHCs, where they pay 80% of the RHC AIR? or DSNP plans have their own assigned rate that is established annually?

topComments.text: Any MCO methodology is tied to contract terms. If the contract honors the Medicare cost-based reimbursement then it should mimic the RWB AIR.  Likewise, Medicaid MCOs will follow legacy RHC state rates unless the contract states otherwise.  Charles James, can you please address any Illinois specifics?

Upcoming Rural Rounds Cancellation & Conference Schedule

Please note that Rural Rounds will be cancelled on September 16 and September 30 so our team and community can attend the NRHA Conference and the NAHRC Fall Institute!

We hope to see you at one or both of these events. If you're attending, keep an eye out for your fellow "Rural Rounders" and be sure to connect!

Not attending this time around? Use the break to catch up on past sessions by visiting www.empowerruralhs.com/ruralrounds.
